name: Lucida (egeorcun/lucida)
notes: BiRefNet_HR fine-tune (~885 MB, MIT). Landed in Comfy-Org/BiRefNet Jul 26-28 2026 (within window). Targets edge cases: semi-transparent glass, camouflage, VFX glow, line-art with soft shadows. Already surfaced by ComfyUI-RMBG v3.1.0. Drop-in checkpoint addition, no pipeline change required. Tier 1.

name: JoyAI-Image-Edit-Plus (jdopensource/JoyAI-Image-Edit-Plus-ComfyUI)
notes: Apache 2.0. Qwen3-VL 8B MLLM fused with 16B MMDiT for instruction-guided image editing. Substantially better face/identity preservation than Qwen Image Edit 2509 (no face drift). Supports up to 3 reference images. INT8 format feasible at 16 GB VRAM (recommended over FP8 for RTX 5060 Ti). GGUF quant (vantagewithai/JoyAI-Image-Edit-Plus-ComfyUI-GGUF, Jul 17, 6.3K downloads). Comfy-Org/JoyAI-Image-Edit official wrapper created Jul 20. Native ComfyUI support shipped v0.29.0 Jul 29. Tier 1 — quality path upgrade for build_qwen_edit.

name: Mage-Flow-Edit-Turbo (microsoft/Mage-Flow-Edit-Turbo)
notes: MIT. 4B instruction-based image editor, 4-step Turbo (1.02 s/edit on A100). FP16 peak 18-20 GB (too large at 16 GB). NVFP4 quant for NVIDIA Blackwell/RTX 50xx (incl. RTX 5060 Ti): ~2.2 GB — excellent fit. FP8 quant for non-Blackwell ~12 GB also available (rootlocalghost family Jul 30; szwagros Aug 1). Benchmarks vs 20B+ models. Tier 1 — speed path upgrade for build_qwen_edit. Native ComfyUI v0.29.0 (CORE-372).

name: LTX 2.3 IC-LoRA / ID-LoRA (ComfyUI v0.29.0 improved detection)
notes: ComfyUI v0.29.0 (Jul 29) fixed IC-LoRA model detection for LTX-Video. Current build_ltx_video does not expose ic_lora_filename, id_lora_filename, ic_strength params. Adding these unlocks IC-LoRA (camera-motion V2V) and ID-LoRA (identity-preserving video) natively. No new model download required — LTX-2.3 already ships these LoRA files. Tier 1 additive parameter exposure.

name: SeedVR2 v2.5 + native ComfyUI v0.28.0 support
notes: ComfyUI v0.28.0 (Jul 15) added native SeedVR2 image and video upscaling. v2.5 adds flicker-free batch processing (min batch=5 for temporal consistency). Migrate build_seedv2r from custom node to native v0.28.0 loaders to reduce maintenance overhead. No new SeedVR model released in strict window — this is an infrastructure migration opportunity. Tier 1.

name: SAM 3 — official Meta open-source release (facebookresearch/sam3)
notes: Meta open-sourced SAM 3 on Jul 17 2026 (borderline, 9 days before window). Adds Promptable Concept Segmentation across images and video; doubles prior-SOTA accuracy. Verify all three build_sam3_* builders use official facebookresearch/sam3 weights (not a SAM 2 fallback or pre-release stub). 16 GB VRAM sufficient. Low-priority verification task.

name: SAM 3 — official Meta open-source release (facebookresearch/sam3)
notes: Same as build_sam3_segment. Verify official weights are in use.

name: SAM 3 — official Meta open-source release (facebookresearch/sam3)
notes: Same as build_sam3_segment. Verify official weights are in use.

name: Hunyuan3D 3.1 / PolyGen (cloud Partner Node)
notes: Hunyuan3D 3.x (PolyGen art-grade retopology announced Jul 7 2026) substantially supersedes open-source 2.1 for mesh quality. Cloud-only — requires Tencent API, not self-hostable. Flagged still_sota=false because the field has moved; practical adoption requires API key or waiting for open-source release. Local Hunyuan3D-2.1 remains best 16 GB option. Tier 3.
replacement: Hunyuan3D 3.1 (cloud Partner Node); Hunyuan3D-2.1 remains best local option

name: Hunyuan3D 3.1 / PolyGen (cloud Partner Node)
notes: Same as build_hunyuan_3d_mesh. Hunyuan3D-2.1 PBR texturing remains best local self-hostable option on 16 GB.
replacement: Hunyuan3D 3.1 (cloud Partner Node); Hunyuan3D-2.1 remains best local option

name: Microsoft Mage-Flow T2I (microsoft/Mage-Flow + Mage-Flow-Turbo)
notes: NEW BUILDER NEEDED (Tier 2). Microsoft 4B native-resolution DiT (MIT). Announced Jul 22, ComfyUI native v0.29.0 (CORE-372). GenEval 0.90 — highest open-source, above FLUX.2 (0.87) and Qwen-Image (0.87). ~9 GB FP16; NVFP4 quant ~2.2 GB for NVIDIA Blackwell RTX 50xx (incl. RTX 5060 Ti). Comfy-Org/Mage-Flow repackage: 75K downloads in <2 weeks. arXiv 2607.19064. Variants: Base, RL-aligned, 4-step Turbo (0.59 s/image). Excellent fit for spellcaster on RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB.

name: Uni3C Camera ControlNet for Wan (native ComfyUI v0.29.0)
notes: NEW BUILDER NEEDED (Tier 2). Uni3C (CORE-365, Jul 29 2026) adds camera-trajectory control to all Wan variants (2.1/2.2/T2V/I2V/VACE/Animate/etc). Weights: Kijai/WanVideo_comfy: Wan21_Uni3C_controlnet_fp16.safetensors and Wan22_Uni3C_controlnet_fp16.safetensors. Native node: WanVideoUni3C_ControlnetLoader. Recommended 24 GB VRAM; 16 GB marginal (block-swap or GGUF Q4 may work on RTX 5060 Ti). Medium risk on target hardware.

name: MiniMax H3 (open-source weights pending, announced Jul 31 2026)
notes: NEW BUILDER NEEDED (Tier 3 — monitor). MiniMax H3 launched Jul 31 2026 as API. 2K video + natively synced audio, 15 s clips. Benchmarks above Seedance 2.0. Open-source weights announced for 'early August'. ComfyUI v0.29.2 added API support. As of Aug 2, no public checkpoint confirmed. Once weights + VRAM specs are known, will need build_minimax_h3_video builder. Revisit next week.

name: FLUX 3 — Black Forest Labs (announced only, no weights)
notes: Tier 3 — monitor. Announced Jul 23 2026. Multimodal (image + up to 20s video + audio). Image variant described as better than FLUX.2 on complex prompts and multilingual text rendering. Open-weight FLUX 3 Dev planned for Q4 2026 — no timeline confirmed. No local weights, no ComfyUI support as of Aug 2. When weights drop, will require new builders for image and multimodal generation. Watch huggingface.co/black-forest-labs.

name: Krea 2 Style Reference LoRA (ostris/krea2_turbo_style_reference)
notes: Tier 3 (VRAM + license). Style reference LoRA for Krea 2 Turbo (12.9B MMDiT). Released Jul 8 by ostris; native ComfyUI support via PR#14843 shipped in v0.29.0 Jul 29 (in-window). Accepts 1-2 reference images; matches style without trigger word. Krea 2 Turbo FP8 ≈13 GB — tight on 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti. Krea 2 is non-commercial open-weight. Could upgrade build_style_transfer paradigm (IPAdapter SDXL → Krea2 LoRA) but license and VRAM constraints require hardware test first.
replacement: Krea 2 Style Reference LoRA on Krea 2 Turbo FP8 (better paradigm, pending VRAM test)

name: Wan-Dancer-14B (Wan-AI/Wan-Dancer-14B)
notes: NEW BUILDER NEEDED (Tier 3 near-miss — released Jul 13, 13 days before window). Apache 2.0. Music + reference image → long-duration rhythmic dance video. ComfyUI native tutorial at docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/wan/wan-dancer. INT8/INT4 convrot quant (Winnougan/Wan-Dancer-14B-INT8-INT4-Convrot) makes 16 GB feasible. No spellcaster builder. Consider build_wan_dancer_video in next sprint.

name: ID-V2V (Eyeline-Labs/ID-V2V, arXiv:2607.22830)
notes: Tier 3 — not viable at 16 GB. SIGGRAPH Asia 2026. Identity-preserving video restyling (Wan 2.1 + VACE). Tested on 8x A100-80GB; ~96 GB checkpoint. Completely incompatible with 16 GB VRAM. Monitor for quantized variants in 12-18 months.

name: FaceFusion 3.8.0 (infrastructure only)
notes: Released Jul 31 2026 (in-window). Infrastructure-only update: AV1 codec, alpha channel support, HDR color fixes, FFmpeg manager. No new face swap or restoration models. FaceFusion is a standalone CLI/GUI tool, not a native ComfyUI node pack (unofficial wrapper unmaintained). Not actionable for build_faceswap_mtb. No new swap model.

name: FeyNoBg (feyninc/feynobg) — near-miss, no ComfyUI node yet
notes: Released Jul 21 2026 (5 days before window). 263M-param SOTA on 4 standard background-removal benchmarks (within 2% on the rest). BiRefNet-based. Currently HF Space + Python library only — no loadable safetensors checkpoint or ComfyUI node. Monitor feyninc on HuggingFace for checkpoint/node release.

name: Anima-LLLite (kohya-ss/Anima-LLLite)
notes: Tier 3 (architecture not in scope). Lightweight ControlNet-LLLite for Anima DiT (anime-focused diffusion model). Native ComfyUI v0.29.0 support (PR#14954). Control types: lineart, depth, pose, fake scribble, inpainting. Low VRAM overhead (LoRA-style injection). Additive only if Anima becomes a spellcaster backbone. Filed as architecture-watch.
